BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   C. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   C. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   B. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Money as rumours only.
   C. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money.

8. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.

9. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.

12. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   C. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance 3.2 International Trade 4.0 Financial Records in Business 4.1 Bus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Business Transactions 4.2 Effects of Business Transactions 4.3 Source Documents  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. D — Plan income and spending wisely

3. A — Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. C — Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Public Finance 3.2 International Trade 4.0 Financial Records in Business 4.1 Bus; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Public Finance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of International Trade; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Business Transactions 4.2 Effects of Business Transactions 4.3 Source Documents ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
